name: Blade and Tankard Defense (Combat)
body:
You can use your fighting tankard to parry enemy attacks.

Prerequisites(s): Catch Off-Guard or Divine Fighting Technique (Blade and Tankard Style), Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Fighting.

Benefit(s): When you are wielding a tankard in your off-hand, you can choose to not attack with the tankard in a round and instead use it for defense in that round. If you do, the tankard counts as a heavy wooden shield for all feats and prerequisites.
